Usage analytics

RepoShelf can use first-party analytics in this browser to see which features are used. They use random identifiers and never store your search text or IP address. Accepting the terms switched this on; you can turn it off here at any time. The setting applies to this browser only.

Download your data

Your JSON export includes likes, verified public forks, viewing history and preferences, agreement records, submissions, reports and promotion records. It contains private account information; keep it somewhere safe.

Delete your account

This permanently removes your RepoShelf login, likes, verified fork tracking, viewing history, submissions and agreement records. Your GitHub account, repositories and forks are unaffected. Public catalogue listings remain available.

Completed paid promotion history and moderation decisions may be retained privately with account references removed. Reserved or running promotions must be resolved first. The last administrator must assign another administrator before deleting their account.

Deletion requires a GitHub sign-in within the last 15 minutes. Sign in again if needed.
